inputs.original_text: Amid escalating Middle East tensions, the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran via Pakistan. Iran presented five counter-conditions, seeking an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of its sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel remains sceptical that Iran will accept the plan and emphasises its right to pre-emptive strikes, highlighting the complex demands from all sides to end the ongoing conflict.
inputs.modified_text: With tensions escalating in the Middle East, the US proposed a 15-point ceasefire plan to Iran through Pakistan. Iran responded with five counter-conditions, including an end to aggression, compensation, and recognition of its sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz. Israel remains sceptical that Iran will accept the plan and has emphasised its right to pre-emptive strikes, underscoring the complex demands facing efforts to end the ongoing conflict.
